scope: Independent metric math, font-path assembly, displayed graph geometry and editorial-causal interpretation review. Raster generation code statically checked; full-page rendered visual review belongs to rendering audit.

checks.check: Twelve same-word 32pt measurements in advance-by-48pt boxes
Ink ratios agree with independently recomputed formula
Raster samples converge to far below printed precision
HB glyph assembly hash and four x-span gaps agree

evidence.signed_zero_equivalence: -0.0 and0.0 are identical geometric coordinates; only this serialization difference normalized

checks.check: Negative brush bounding-x gap is retained
Every displayed ink bar uses a single explicit 0–40% scale
Sixty displayed selected body spans retain the actual HB x positions
Printed legends identify ratio denominator, approximation and editorial voice
Twelve visual observations lead to explicitly personal voices
Summary converts observations into six concrete selection situations

interpretation_notes: Coverage is normalized by each font actual shaped word advance and a common48pt height, so it measures ink density inside that word box, not total ink area or a standardized weight score.
Projected glyph-body spans and their gaps are horizontal outline bounds, not a font designer kerning adjustment or a claim of physical stroke collision.
Actual nonzero raster union is authoritative: simple signed areas can cancel for BlackHan because its disconnected component windings differ.
Personal voice and font-use labels are explicitly editorial interpretations supported by observed form; no objective emotional score is claimed.
